topics.title: Institutional tools
topics.summary: Cardiff lists Copilot, Gemini and NotebookLM as institutionally available to staff and students through university accounts. Assessment permission is separate.
topics.scope: Institutional account access; individual activation and prices have not been tested.

claims.text: Cardiff lists Copilot, Gemini and NotebookLM as institutionally available to staff and students through university accounts. Assessment permission is separate.

evidence.quote: For Cardiff staff and students, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini and NotebookLM are institutionally available GenAI tools. University accounts should be used to access these platforms, as they align with Cardiff University’s institutional security standards, handle data appropriately, and are approved for use within Cardiff’s digital tool environment.
evidence.title: Generative AI in Learning and Teaching
